scalability_assessment.notes: Architecture supports moderate scale with batch processing patterns

bottlenecks.impact: Linear scaling for large content sets; no parallelism
bottlenecks.recommendation: Implement concurrent embedding requests or use OpenAI batch embedding endpoint

bottlenecks.issue: O(n) content iteration for fallback similarity search
bottlenecks.impact: Performance degrades with content corpus size
bottlenecks.recommendation: Ensure pgvector RPC is always available; add index optimization

bottlenecks.issue: Synchronous LLM calls per taxonomy page
bottlenecks.impact: LLM rate limits and latency compound linearly
bottlenecks.recommendation: Consider batch LLM inference or async processing

bottlenecks.issue: N+1 query pattern for categorization lookup
bottlenecks.impact: One DB call per matched content item
bottlenecks.recommendation: Batch categorization lookup or join query

scaling_strengths.description: bulk_upsert_content(), bulk_upsert_taxonomy(), bulk_upsert_matchings() with configurable chunk_size
scaling_strengths.benefit: Efficient batch persistence reduces DB round-trips
Database-side vector search scales better than client-side
Can recover from failures without full reprocessing

scaling_strengths.description: resume flag and since parameter for WordPress ingestion

capacity_recommendations.recommendation: Ensure pgvector indexes are optimized; consider async embedding generation
Add worker queue for parallel processing; implement batch LLM inference; consider caching layer
